column7: UpdateUserRoles (PUT /api/v1/users/{id}/roles) passed the machine-actor flag to core.SetUserRoles but never tagged ctx with core.WithSelfMachineGranter, so the grant ceiling refused every directly authenticated machine actor regardless of its real roles.assign authority (fail-closed). Found by TestEveryDirectMachineGrantEntryTagsSelfGranter (INV-UNGUARDED-1); fixed by tagging ctx on the machine branch, as the sibling handlers do.
